visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven final portable views and full Casa Grande facade frame against the local Qualla front/side originals. Twin tiled octagonal bell towers, lower blind arches, gold fanlight gate, raised timber balcony, roof soffit, rear wings, detached guest-house plans, pool colonnades and temple remain distinct. Initial envelope occlusion and open roof backdrop were corrected. Additional pool and Casa del Sol close views resolved buried columns, overlapping windows and stair-ground joins.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven final shared-material views including north-up placement overlay. Plain concrete, painted metal and roof graph retain metric UV bindings with portable glazing. Transform, reference-point sampling, unload and graph reads pass. The flat shared fixture hides parts below its plane, including the lower guest houses and pools; it establishes materials and transforms only. Preserved local-terrain portable and medium-fi views establish site ground contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen final medium-fi frames across lights, quality settings, front/back, silhouette and four forced detail levels. Whole hilltop site fits the context views at scale 3. Paired towers, rear wing silhouette, three detached guest houses and pool remain identifiable. Skyline/district simplify roofs and omit tiny ornament; middle distance omits bell hardware. Neighboring blocks are a synthetic style fixture, not the estate. No physical-device performance claim.

Raised forecourt 0.8 m, entrance landing 3.8 m, Neptune deck -13.2 m and Casa del Sol roof/terrace -6/-14.6 m are inferred architectural levels that avoid burying visible elements; not surveyed heights. Foundations and retaining walls enter the preserved hill. Shared flat fixture cannot establish these vertical relations. Footprint suppression remains off.

fidelityReview.scope: Casa Grande, three named guest houses, Neptune pool architectural setting, Roman Pool exterior and immediate terraces; broader estate and interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Accepted original coordinated medium-fi exterior from two primary Qualla photographs and six individually inspected supplementary local references. Resolved incorrect Casa del Sol hero attribution against the original Commons display. Historical 1941 aerial supplies layout only. Main facade, towers, guest-house roof directions, pool temple/curved colonnades and terraced site are retained. Sculptures, ornament, pool perimeter, retaining joins, hidden windows and vertical levels remain generalized; straight stair flights approximate the curved Casa del Sol arrangement. Interiors, broad gardens, estate service buildings and vegetation are excluded. No reference photos are embedded or redistributed.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current hash-bound detail levels pass strict budgets and were inspected. Skyline, district and street are authored from the same researched site; middle-distance bell hardware and fine window moldings are omitted to meet budgets. Error values are authoring limits, not independently measured mesh distances.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact source regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; terrain PNG round-trip error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi coordinated exterior from inspected Qualla photographs and map/terrain controls; not an architectural or land survey.

Main facade and twin towers, rear wing layout, three guest-house footprints, pool temple/colonnades and terraced setting are retained. Fine carved figures, tile motifs, unseen window rhythms, interiors and complete garden ornament are generalized or omitted.
The 1941 aerial is supplementary layout evidence only. Modern exterior photographs control visible fabric; exact current roof services and restoration details remain uncertain.

Neptune pool center is mapped; basin dimensions come from California State Parks. Detailed curved perimeter, retaining joins and vertical terrace levels are interpretations, with unmodified host terrain retained for review.

Guest roofs and hidden sides are conservative approximations. Outlying service buildings, the broader estate, vegetation and zoo are outside this model. Reference photos are not embedded or redistributed.
